desktop.notes:
• Backup numbers are right: over 2 GB the bar, sizes and time left went wrong ("1.5 GB of 1.4 GB", negative numbers). Now they match, and time left follows the recent speed.
• Back up & verify checks each file while the next one copies - the whole job finishes sooner. The bar shows the whole job.
• The "about …" estimate learns from your own backups and hides while a job runs.
• Second copy: unticking "Use" dims the whole area.
• Dashboard: backup time never counts as culling; backups show under the session ("Backed up").
• 🏆 High scores in the dashboard - the fastest culling sessions (50+ photos), arcade style.
